info.title: Firealerts API
info.description: Satellite wildfire detection, forecasting and alerting. Authenticate with `Authorization: Bearer <token or API key>`; select an organisation with `X-Org-Id`.

get.description: Everything a client needs to render forms and options.
Public data sources with live status where the platform ingests them.

post.description: Always 202, so the endpoint does not reveal which e-mails have accounts.

get.description: Never 401s for anonymous callers: clients use it to decide whether to show sign-in.

delete.description: Delete the account. Organisations where the user is the only owner must be handed over first.

post.description: Create assets from GeoJSON, KML/KMZ or a zipped Shapefile (one asset per polygon feature).
dNBR burn severity between a pre-fire and a post-fire Sentinel-2 scene.

get.description: Printable situation report (save as PDF from the browser).
What-if: spread forecast for a hypothetical ignition at a point.
Probability of at least one satellite fire detection per cell, today and for the next 7 days.
